item.title: Strengthening the Social Enterprise Ecosystem in Malaysia: SEAM’s Journey - Biji-biji Initiative
item.description: Our journey in strengthening Malaysia's social enterprise ecosystem underscores the importance of aligning efforts and building partnerships. SEAM connects social enterprises with key players to amplify impact, fostering a cohesive ecosystem that supports their growth and uplifts communities that are marginalised, driving lasting positive change for Malaysia.

SEAM proudly supports these changemakers, 70% of whom are women-led, as they transform communities through innovation and resilience. item.title: SEAM: Mid-programme Reflections - Biji-biji Initiative
item.description: Over the past six months, ten social enterprises have put in dedicated effort, overcome challenges, and shared ideas as they grow together. As we look back on the journey so far, it’s clear that progress is being made, but there’s still more to learn and achieve. Read the full article.

item.title: Celebrating World Environment Day: From Circular Ideas to Collective Impact - Biji-biji Initiative
item.description: This World Environment Day, we reflect on our journey at Biji-biji—from turning discarded banners into fashion statements to launching community-powered recycling programmes and environmental accelerators. Over the years, we’ve learned that sustainability isn’t just about systems—it’s about people, imagination, and working together toward a more circular, inclusive, and regenerative future. Here's how far we've come, and where we're headed next.

item.title: International Social Enterprise Day: Reflecting on Malaysia’s Collective Journey - Biji-biji Initiative
item.description: Malaysia’s social enterprise movement thrives on collaboration and shared purpose. From uplifting communities to advancing climate action, social enterprises, ecosystem builders, and initiatives like SEWF 2025 and Earth Heir’s 1% Pledge show that impact grows when people work together. This Social Enterprise Day celebrates the collective journey and calls for a connected, supportive, and human-centered ecosystem.
